name: vision_keras_cnn
title: A Keras CNN fed by tf.data: split before shuffle, augmentation on the training half only, logits head with from_logits=True
origin: domain-vision round 1: the Keras image-classification tutorial shape, written the way that keeps the holdout a holdout

forbidden.why: the take/skip holdout is carved out of the ORDERED base dataset and only the training half is shuffled afterwards - the documented 'split first, shuffle the training half' guard
the output layer is a bare Dense(num_classes) with no activation, which is the correct partner for SparseCategoricalCrossentropy(from_logits=True)
set_seeds() calls np.random.seed, tf.random.set_seed and keras.utils.set_random_seed, and main() calls it first
the split is a deterministic take/skip on an ordered dataset, and the shuffle that follows carries seed=
the augment map is applied to the training dataset only; the validation and test datasets go straight to batch/prefetch
